data.body: **[P2] Keep symlink rejection out of transient retries.** `NOFOLLOW_LINKS` failures can surface as `IOException`, so this broad wrapper converts a permanent invalid/symlink path into `RetryableSerDesException`; `readPayload()` does the same. `RetrySerDes` will consequently delay and retry a security violation until exhaustion. Detect symlinks relative to the held secure directory and throw plain `SerDesException`, retaining retryability only for genuinely transient I/O, with a test asserting a wrapped SerDes attempts once.
